name: Markdown-related Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: "*"

jobs:
  markdown-related-check:
    name: markdown-related check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Check out code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Markdown Link Check
      uses: docker://dragonflyoss/linter:v0.2.7
      with:
        # validate all links in markdown files excluding vendor folder
        args: bash -c "code=0;for mdFile in $(find ./ -name '*.md' | grep -v vendor); do markdown-link-check -q --config .github/workflows/.mlc_config.json $mdFile; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then code=1; fi;done; echo $code; exit $code"

    - name:  Markdown Lint
      uses: docker://dragonflyoss/linter:v0.2.7
      with:
        # lint all markdown files excluding vendor folder
        args: bash -c "find ./ -name '*.md' | grep -v vendor | grep -v .github | xargs mdl -r ~MD010,~MD013,~MD022,~MD024,~MD026,~MD029,~MD033,~MD036"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

Pattern: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job_timeout)

When is bound jobs with a custom timeout applicable?

Assess bound jobs with a custom timeout for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Representative successful-duration history exists

Contraindications: Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit

Method: Choose an explicit budget with operational headroom; Measure false timeout failures separately

Reported finding: Custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption.
